description: Land Title Settlement Department - Andiambalama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances) in the Village of Andiambalama. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
